page.overview:
Who is Dissidia Duellum Final Fantasy characters?

The following is a list of playable characters in Dissidia Duellum Final Fantasy.

All characters and their alternate outfits are treated as separate units for purposes of gameplay and customization, and are obtained exclusively through Character Draw gacha banners, with one of the ten initial characters selected by the player during registration as their personal avatar and fighter. The player also selects which outfit they wish their representative to wear. After the choice of character has been made, the remaining characters must then be drawn at random from the gacha. Each pull costs one (1) character draw ticket. If the player should wish to obtain a specific character, then five (5) draw tickets are required; the character will have their default appearance, and no additional items will be pulled. Characters, their icons, and other bonus content can also be acquired through the regular Season Pass available with each new season, plus additional rewards available on the premium track of each season.

If the player already has the character and the same outfits are drawn, the excess pulls will be converted into Job Medals used in upgrades for that character. New outfits will be integrated into the character's current inventory. Additional outfits do not reassign the character's role.

New characters may receive their own draw banners for a period of time before entering the general pool, during which drop rates for their outfits and abilities may be boosted on said banners. The cost of pulling on these banners can vary, as does the number of pulls in their multi-draw option.
